meta.series: DSA for Freshers: Mid-level Company Roadmap
meta.batch: Part 2: Prefix Sum + HashMap, Difference Array, Two Pointers (advanced)
meta.note: company_tags indicative hain (frequently asked trends), official guarantee nahi.

theory.concept: Prefix sum pre[i] = a[0] + ... + a[i-1] (size n+1, pre[0] = 0). Fir kisi bhi range [L, R] ka sum pre[R+1] - pre[L] se O(1) me milta hai. Query bahut ho to har baar loop chalana O(n*q) hota hai, prefix se O(n + q).
key_points: 1D: sum(L..R) = pre[R+1] - pre[L]
2D: pre[i+1][j+1] = m[i][j] + pre[i][j+1] + pre[i+1][j] - pre[i][j] (inclusion-exclusion)
Product except self: left prefix product * right suffix product (division ke bina, zeros bhi handle ho jate hain)
Prefix array ek baar banta hai, queries immutable data par hi sahi rehti hain
pitfalls: pre ka size n (n+1 nahi) rakh dena
2D me aakhri term (+ pre[r1][c1]) bhool jana

theory.concept: Subarray (i..j] ka sum k hai to pre[j] - pre[i] = k, yani pre[i] = pre[j] - k. Isliye har j par dekho ki 'pre[j] - k' pehle kitni baar aa chuka hai. Ye negatives ke saath bhi kaam karta hai (sliding window nahi karta).
key_points: Count chahiye to cnt[prefix]++ rakho aur answer += cnt[pre - k]
Longest chahiye to sirf pehli occurrence (first index) rakho
Seed zaroori: cnt[0] = 1 (ya first[0] = -1) taaki array ke start se shuru hone wale subarrays count hon
Sliding window tabhi lagta hai jab elements non-negative ho (monotonic sum); negatives me prefix + HashMap
Binary array me 0 ko -1 maan lo to 'equal 0 aur 1' sum = 0 ki problem ban jati hai
pitfalls: Update ko query se pehle kar dena (k = 0 par galat count)
Longest ke liye har baar index overwrite karna (first occurrence rakho)

theory.concept: Subarray sum k se divisible hai <=> pre[j] % k == pre[i] % k. Isliye remainders ko count/first-index ke saath map karo. Negative numbers me remainder ko ((s % k) + k) % k se normalize karo.
key_points: Same remainder wale prefix pairs = divisible subarrays
Count ke liye cnt[rem]++, answer += cnt[rem] (update se pehle)
Length >= 2 wali condition me first index rakho aur i - first >= 2 check karo
Seed remainder 0 ko index -1 (ya count 1) ke saath
pitfalls: C++ me negative % negative hi deta hai
k = 0 special case (agar problem allow kare)
s + x overflow (long long ya har step mod)

theory.concept: Bahut saare 'range [l, r] me +v karo' updates ho aur end me final array chahiye to d[l] += v aur d[r+1] -= v karo. Fir d ka prefix sum final array deta hai. Har update O(1), total O(n + q).
key_points: Update: d[l] += v, d[r + 1] -= v
Final: running sum of d
Flight bookings, car pooling, range addition, meeting rooms count sab isi pattern ke hain
Array size n + 2 rakho taaki r + 1 safe rahe
pitfalls: Capacity check me '>' vs '>=' (drop-off point par passengers utar jate hain)

theory.topic: Two Pointers on Sorted Arrays (3Sum, 4Sum, kSum)
theory.concept: Sort karo. Pehle k-2 elements ko loops se fix karo aur bache hue do ko l aur r pointers se dhundo. Sum chhota ho to l++, bada ho to r--. Duplicates skip karke unique tuples milte hain.
key_points: 3Sum O(n^2), 4Sum O(n^3), brute me ye O(n^3) aur O(n^4) hote hain
Duplicate skip: i par if(i > 0 && a[i] == a[i-1]) continue; match ke baad l aur r ko same values se aage badhao
Closest sum: har step par best update karo aur diff ke hisab se pointer chalao
Counting problems (triangle, sum condition): fixed largest/smallest ke saath pointers; match par poora range count (r - l)
Sorting se original indices kho jate hain, agar indices chahiye to pair (value, index) sort karo
pitfalls: Duplicate skip galat jagah (i ke liye bhi aur l/r ke liye bhi chahiye)

theory.topic: Two Pointers: Greedy Shrink (Container, Trapping Water, Boats)
theory.concept: Dono ends par pointers; jis side ka 'limiting factor' chhota hai, usi pointer ko move karo, kyunki dusri side ko move karne se answer improve nahi ho sakta. Isse O(n) me n^2 pairs ka kaam ho jata hai.
key_points: Container With Most Water: area = min(h[l], h[r]) * (r - l); chhoti height wala pointer move karo
Trapping Rain Water: lmax/rmax maintain karo; chhoti side ka water pakka (limiting side wahi hai)
Boats: sort karke heaviest + lightest ko pair karo; pair na bane to heaviest akela jata hai
Backspace compare: peeche se scan karke skip count se chhupe hue characters chhodo (O(1) space)
pitfalls: Dono pointers ek saath move karna
Equal heights par kaun sa pointer hataye (koi bhi chalta hai)
Trapping water me water negative ho jana (lmax update pehle karo)

problems.title: Range Sum Query (Immutable)
problems.problem_statement: Given an array and multiple queries (L, R), return the sum of elements between indices L and R inclusive for each query.
problems.description: Array change nahi hota, queries bahut hoti hain.
problems.theory: pre[i+1] = pre[i] + a[i]. Query answer = pre[R+1] - pre[L].

brute_force.approach: Har query ke liye L se R tak loop.
brute_force.code_cpp: vector<int> rangeSums(const vector<int>& a, const vector<pair<int,int>>& q){ vector<int> r; for(auto& p : q){ int s = 0; for(int i = p.first; i <= p.second; i++) s += a[i]; r.push_back(s); } return r; }

optimized.approach: Prefix sum array ek baar, har query O(1).
optimized.code_cpp: vector<int> rangeSums(const vector<int>& a, const vector<pair<int,int>>& q){ int n = a.size(); vector<int> pre(n + 1, 0); for(int i = 0; i < n; i++) pre[i+1] = pre[i] + a[i]; vector<int> r; for(auto& p : q) r.push_back(pre[p.second + 1] - pre[p.first]); return r; }

problems.explanation: Extra (n+1) space se query cost O(n) se O(1) ho gayi. Prefix sum aage ke saare subarray-sum patterns ki buniyad hai.

problems.title: Product of Array Except Self
problems.problem_statement: Given an array, return an array where answer[i] is the product of all elements except a[i]. Do not use division and solve in O(n).
problems.description: Zeros ho sakte hain, isliye division approach unsafe hai.
problems.theory: answer[i] = (i se pehle sabka product) * (i ke baad sabka product). Pehle left pass, phir right pass me suffix product multiply karo.

brute_force.approach: Har i ke liye baaki sab elements multiply karo.
brute_force.code_cpp: vector<int> productExceptSelf(const vector<int>& a){ int n = a.size(); vector<int> r(n, 1); for(int i = 0; i < n; i++) for(int j = 0; j < n; j++) if(i != j) r[i] *= a[j]; return r; }

optimized.approach: Left products output array me, phir right se suffix product.
optimized.code_cpp: vector<int> productExceptSelf(const vector<int>& a){ int n = a.size(); vector<int> r(n, 1); for(int i = 1; i < n; i++) r[i] = r[i-1] * a[i-1]; int suf = 1; for(int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--){ r[i] *= suf; suf *= a[i]; } return r; }

problems.explanation: Total product / a[i] zero par fail hota hai. Prefix aur suffix products dono alag alag pass me combine hote hain, isliye zero automatically sahi handle hota hai.

problems.title: Range Sum Query 2D (Immutable)
problems.problem_statement: Given a 2D matrix and multiple queries (r1, c1, r2, c2), return the sum of elements inside the rectangle for each query.
problems.description: Matrix immutable hai aur queries bahut hain.
problems.theory: 2D prefix: pre[i+1][j+1] = m[i][j] + pre[i][j+1] + pre[i+1][j] - pre[i][j]. Rectangle sum inclusion-exclusion se.

brute_force.approach: Har query me rectangle ke andar sab cells jodo.
brute_force.code_cpp: vector<int> sumRegions(const vector<vector<int>>& m, const vector<array<int,4>>& q){ vector<int> r; for(auto& x : q){ int s = 0; for(int i = x[0]; i <= x[2]; i++) for(int j = x[1]; j <= x[3]; j++) s += m[i][j]; r.push_back(s); } return r; }

optimized.code_cpp: vector<int> sumRegions(const vector<vector<int>>& m, const vector<array<int,4>>& q){ int R = m.size(), C = m[0].size(); vector<vector<int>> pre(R + 1, vector<int>(C + 1, 0)); for(int i = 0; i < R; i++) for(int j = 0; j < C; j++) pre[i+1][j+1] = m[i][j] + pre[i][j+1] + pre[i+1][j] - pre[i][j]; vector<int> r; for(auto& x : q) r.push_back(pre[x[2]+1][x[3]+1] - pre[x[0]][x[3]+1] - pre[x[2]+1][x[1]] + pre[x[0]][x[1]]); return r; }

problems.explanation: Inclusion-exclusion: bada rectangle - upar wala - left wala + dono ka overlap (jo do baar ghat gaya tha).

problems.title: Corporate Flight Bookings
problems.problem_statement: There are n flights labeled 1..n. Each booking [first, last, seats] reserves seats on every flight from first to last. Return the total seats booked on each flight.
problems.description: Har booking ek range update hai.
problems.theory: Difference array: d[first] += seats, d[last+1] -= seats. Final = prefix sum of d.

brute_force.approach: Har booking ke liye first se last tak loop chalake add.
brute_force.code_cpp: vector<int> corpFlightBookings(const vector<array<int,3>>& b, int n){ vector<int> r(n, 0); for(auto& x : b) for(int i = x[0]; i <= x[1]; i++) r[i-1] += x[2]; return r; }

optimized.code_cpp: vector<int> corpFlightBookings(const vector<array<int,3>>& b, int n){ vector<int> d(n + 2, 0); for(auto& x : b){ d[x[0]] += x[2]; d[x[1] + 1] -= x[2]; } vector<int> r(n); int cur = 0; for(int i = 1; i <= n; i++){ cur += d[i]; r[i-1] = cur; } return r; }

problems.explanation: Range update ko do point updates me badal diya. Saare updates ke baad ek hi prefix pass me final array mil jata hai.

problems.title: Car Pooling
problems.problem_statement: A car has a given capacity. trips[i] = [passengers, from, to]: passengers are picked up at 'from' and dropped at 'to'. Return true if all trips can be done without ever exceeding capacity.
problems.description: Drop-off point par passengers utar jaate hain, naye us point par chadh sakte hain.
problems.theory: Difference array over locations: d[from] += n, d[to] -= n. Prefix sum se har location par load aur check load <= capacity.

brute_force.approach: Har location (0..1000) par saare trips scan karke load nikalo.
brute_force.code_cpp: bool carPooling(const vector<array<int,3>>& t, int cap){ for(int loc = 0; loc <= 1000; loc++){ int load = 0; for(auto& x : t) if(x[1] <= loc && loc < x[2]) load += x[0]; if(load > cap) return false; } return true; }

optimized.code_cpp: bool carPooling(const vector<array<int,3>>& t, int cap){ vector<int> d(1002, 0); for(auto& x : t){ d[x[1]] += x[0]; d[x[2]] -= x[0]; } int cur = 0; for(int i = 0; i <= 1000; i++){ cur += d[i]; if(cur > cap) return false; } return true; }

problems.explanation: 'to' par -= karne se drop-off point par passengers utarna model ho jata hai (half-open interval [from, to)).
edge_cases: Boundary pickup and dropoff at same point

problems.title: Subarray Sum Equals K
problems.problem_statement: Given an integer array and k, return the total number of contiguous subarrays whose sum equals k.
problems.description: Array me negative numbers ho sakte hain, isliye sliding window nahi chalega.
problems.theory: pre[j] - pre[i] = k => pre[i] = pre[j] - k. HashMap me prefix sums ki frequency rakho (cnt[0] = 1 se start).

brute_force.approach: Har start se end tak running sum, k ke barabar hone par count++.
brute_force.code_cpp: int subarraySum(const vector<int>& a, int k){ int n = a.size(), r = 0; for(int i = 0; i < n; i++){ int s = 0; for(int j = i; j < n; j++){ s += a[j]; if(s == k) r++; } } return r; }

optimized.code_cpp: int subarraySum(const vector<int>& a, int k){ unordered_map<long long,int> cnt; cnt[0] = 1; long long s = 0; int r = 0; for(int x : a){ s += x; auto it = cnt.find(s - k); if(it != cnt.end()) r += it->second; cnt[s]++; } return r; }

problems.explanation: Pehle query (cnt[s-k]) phir update (cnt[s]++), warna k = 0 par khud ko count kar leta. Ye prefix+hashmap pattern ka sabse important problem hai.

problems.title: Continuous Subarray Sum
problems.problem_statement: Return true if the array has a subarray of length at least 2 whose sum is a multiple of k.
problems.description: 0 bhi k ka multiple maana jata hai.
problems.theory: Prefix % k same ho to beech ka sum divisible hai. Har remainder ki pehli index rakho aur check karo ki current index se kam se kam 2 door ho.

brute_force.approach: Har (i, j), j > i, ke liye sum nikalo aur % k check karo.
brute_force.code_cpp: bool checkSubarraySum(const vector<int>& a, int k){ int n = a.size(); for(int i = 0; i < n; i++){ long long s = a[i]; for(int j = i + 1; j < n; j++){ s += a[j]; if(s % k == 0) return true; } } return false; }

optimized.code_cpp: bool checkSubarraySum(const vector<int>& a, int k){ unordered_map<int,int> first; first[0] = -1; long long s = 0; for(int i = 0; i < (int)a.size(); i++){ s = (s + a[i]) % k; auto it = first.find((int)s); if(it == first.end()) first[(int)s] = i; else if(i - it->second >= 2) return true; } return false; }

problems.explanation: Pehli occurrence hi rakhte hain taaki subarray sabse lamba mile (length >= 2 ka check aasan ho). first[0] = -1 se array ke shuru wale subarrays cover hote hain.

problems.title: Subarray Sums Divisible by K
problems.problem_statement: Given an integer array and k, return the number of non-empty subarrays whose sum is divisible by k.
problems.description: Negative numbers ho sakte hain.
problems.theory: Prefix remainders ka frequency count. Same remainder wale prefix pairs (nC2) divisible subarrays dete hain. Negative remainder ko normalize karo.

brute_force.approach: Har subarray ka sum aur % k.
brute_force.code_cpp: int subarraysDivByK(const vector<int>& a, int k){ int n = a.size(), r = 0; for(int i = 0; i < n; i++){ long long s = 0; for(int j = i; j < n; j++){ s += a[j]; if(s % k == 0) r++; } } return r; }

optimized.code_cpp: int subarraysDivByK(const vector<int>& a, int k){ vector<int> cnt(k, 0); cnt[0] = 1; int s = 0, r = 0; for(int x : a){ s = ((s + x) % k + k) % k; r += cnt[s]++; } return r; }

problems.explanation: ((s % k) + k) % k negative remainder ko [0, k-1] me laata hai. Subarray Sum Equals K ka remainder-version hai.

problems.title: Contiguous Array
problems.problem_statement: Given a binary array, return the maximum length of a contiguous subarray with an equal number of 0 and 1.
problems.description: 0 aur 1 ki ginti barabar honi chahiye.
problems.theory: 0 ko -1 maan lo. Equal 0 aur 1 <=> sum = 0. Prefix sum ka first-index map rakho; same prefix dobara mile to beech ka sum 0 hai.

brute_force.approach: Har subarray me balance track karo (1 => +1, 0 => -1).
brute_force.code_cpp: int findMaxLength(const vector<int>& a){ int n = a.size(), best = 0; for(int i = 0; i < n; i++){ int bal = 0; for(int j = i; j < n; j++){ bal += a[j] ? 1 : -1; if(bal == 0) best = max(best, j - i + 1); } } return best; }

optimized.code_cpp: int findMaxLength(const vector<int>& a){ unordered_map<int,int> first; first[0] = -1; int s = 0, best = 0; for(int i = 0; i < (int)a.size(); i++){ s += a[i] ? 1 : -1; auto it = first.find(s); if(it == first.end()) first[s] = i; else best = max(best, i - it->second); } return best; }

problems.explanation: Value transform (0 -> -1) se problem 'longest subarray with sum 0' ban gayi. Ye transform kai problems me kaam aata hai.

problems.title: Longest Subarray with Sum K (Negatives Allowed)
problems.problem_statement: Given an array that may contain negative numbers and a value k, find the length of the longest subarray with sum exactly k. Return 0 if none exists.
problems.description: Sliding window yahan fail hota hai kyunki negatives se sum monotonic nahi rehta.
problems.theory: Har prefix sum ki pehli index store karo. Current prefix s par agar s - k pehle dikha hai to length = i - first[s-k].

brute_force.approach: Har start se end tak running sum; k milne par length update.
brute_force.code_cpp: int longestSubarrayK(const vector<int>& a, long long k){ int n = a.size(), best = 0; for(int i = 0; i < n; i++){ long long s = 0; for(int j = i; j < n; j++){ s += a[j]; if(s == k) best = max(best, j - i + 1); } } return best; }

optimized.code_cpp: int longestSubarrayK(const vector<int>& a, long long k){ unordered_map<long long,int> first; first[0] = -1; long long s = 0; int best = 0; for(int i = 0; i < (int)a.size(); i++){ s += a[i]; auto it = first.find(s - k); if(it != first.end()) best = max(best, i - it->second); if(!first.count(s)) first[s] = i; } return best; }

problems.explanation: Longest ke liye first occurrence rakhte hain (overwrite nahi). Count wali problem me frequency rakhte, yahan index.

problems.title: Binary Subarrays With Sum
problems.problem_statement: Given a binary array and an integer goal, return the number of non-empty subarrays whose sum equals goal.
problems.description: Sirf 0 aur 1 hain, isliye prefix sum 0..n ke beech rehta hai (array se bhi count ho sakta hai).
problems.theory: Prefix sum ki frequency array cnt[0..n] rakho. answer += cnt[s - goal]. (Ya atMost(goal) - atMost(goal-1) sliding window.)

brute_force.approach: Har subarray ka sum.
brute_force.code_cpp: int numSubarraysWithSum(const vector<int>& a, int goal){ int n = a.size(), r = 0; for(int i = 0; i < n; i++){ int s = 0; for(int j = i; j < n; j++){ s += a[j]; if(s == goal) r++; } } return r; }

optimized.code_cpp: int numSubarraysWithSum(const vector<int>& a, int goal){ vector<int> cnt(a.size() + 2, 0); cnt[0] = 1; int s = 0, r = 0; for(int x : a){ s += x; if(s >= goal) r += cnt[s - goal]; cnt[s]++; } return r; }

problems.explanation: Prefix sum ki range chhoti (0..n) hai, isliye array HashMap se tez aur simple hai. goal = 0 par bhi seed cnt[0] = 1 sahi count deta hai.

problems.title: Count Subarrays with XOR K
problems.problem_statement: Given an array and an integer k, count the number of subarrays whose XOR equals k.
problems.description: XOR ke liye bhi prefix idea chalta hai kyunki x ^ x = 0.
problems.theory: px[j] ^ px[i] = k => px[i] = px[j] ^ k. Prefix XOR ki frequency map.

brute_force.approach: Har subarray ka XOR running se.
brute_force.code_cpp: long long countXor(const vector<int>& a, int k){ int n = a.size(); long long r = 0; for(int i = 0; i < n; i++){ int x = 0; for(int j = i; j < n; j++){ x ^= a[j]; if(x == k) r++; } } return r; }

optimized.code_cpp: long long countXor(const vector<int>& a, int k){ unordered_map<int,int> cnt; cnt[0] = 1; int x = 0; long long r = 0; for(int v : a){ x ^= v; auto it = cnt.find(x ^ k); if(it != cnt.end()) r += it->second; cnt[x]++; } return r; }

problems.explanation: Sum ki jagah XOR bhi 'invertible operation' hai (a ^ a = 0), isliye Subarray Sum Equals K ka same template chalta hai.

problems.title: 3Sum
problems.problem_statement: Given an integer array, return all unique triplets [a, b, c] such that a + b + c = 0.
problems.description: Solution set me duplicate triplets nahi hone chahiye.
problems.theory: Sort karo. i fix karo, l = i+1 aur r = n-1 pointers. Sum < 0 to l++, > 0 to r--, 0 par record karke dono move aur duplicates skip.

brute_force.approach: Teen nested loops + set se duplicates hatao.
brute_force.code_cpp: vector<vector<int>> threeSum(vector<int> a){ sort(a.begin(), a.end()); set<vector<int>> s; int n = a.size(); for(int i = 0; i < n; i++) for(int j = i + 1; j < n; j++) for(int k = j + 1; k < n; k++) if(a[i] + a[j] + a[k] == 0) s.insert({a[i], a[j], a[k]}); return vector<vector<int>>(s.begin(), s.end()); }

optimized.code_cpp: vector<vector<int>> threeSum(vector<int> a){ sort(a.begin(), a.end()); int n = a.size(); vector<vector<int>> r; for(int i = 0; i < n - 2; i++){ if(a[i] > 0) break; if(i > 0 && a[i] == a[i-1]) continue; int l = i + 1, h = n - 1; while(l < h){ int s = a[i] + a[l] + a[h]; if(s < 0) l++; else if(s > 0) h--; else { r.push_back({a[i], a[l], a[h]}); l++; h--; while(l < h && a[l] == a[l-1]) l++; while(l < h && a[h] == a[h+1]) h--; } } } return r; }

problems.explanation: Sort hone se duplicates adjacent aa jaate hain, isliye set ki zaroorat nahi. a[i] > 0 par break kyunki sorted array me teeno positive honge to sum > 0.

problems.title: 3Sum Closest
problems.problem_statement: Given an array and a target, find three integers whose sum is closest to the target and return that sum.
problems.description: Exactly ek solution assume kiya gaya hai.
problems.theory: Sort + i fix + two pointers. Har sum par best update; sum < target to l++, warna r--; sum == target to turant return.

brute_force.approach: Saare triplets check.
brute_force.code_cpp: int threeSumClosest(const vector<int>& a, int t){ int n = a.size(), best = a[0] + a[1] + a[2]; for(int i = 0; i < n; i++) for(int j = i + 1; j < n; j++) for(int k = j + 1; k < n; k++){ int s = a[i] + a[j] + a[k]; if(abs(s - t) < abs(best - t)) best = s; } return best; }

optimized.code_cpp: int threeSumClosest(vector<int> a, int t){ sort(a.begin(), a.end()); int n = a.size(), best = a[0] + a[1] + a[2]; for(int i = 0; i < n - 2; i++){ int l = i + 1, h = n - 1; while(l < h){ int s = a[i] + a[l] + a[h]; if(abs(s - t) < abs(best - t)) best = s; if(s == t) return s; if(s < t) l++; else h--; } } return best; }

problems.explanation: 3Sum ka hi template hai; yahan 'exactly 0' ke bajay 'minimum |sum - target|' track hota hai. Duplicate skip ki zaroorat nahi (sirf ek sum chahiye).

problems.title: 4Sum
problems.problem_statement: Given an array and a target, return all unique quadruplets whose sum equals the target.
problems.description: Duplicate quadruplets nahi chahiye.
problems.theory: Sort + do nested loops (i, j) + two pointers (l, r). Sum long long me (overflow). Har level par duplicates skip.

brute_force.approach: Chaar nested loops + set.
brute_force.code_cpp: vector<vector<int>> fourSum(vector<int> a, int t){ sort(a.begin(), a.end()); set<vector<int>> s; int n = a.size(); for(int i = 0; i < n; i++) for(int j = i + 1; j < n; j++) for(int k = j + 1; k < n; k++) for(int l = k + 1; l < n; l++) if((long long)a[i] + a[j] + a[k] + a[l] == t) s.insert({a[i], a[j], a[k], a[l]}); return vector<vector<int>>(s.begin(), s.end()); }

optimized.code_cpp: vector<vector<int>> fourSum(vector<int> a, int t){ sort(a.begin(), a.end()); int n = a.size(); vector<vector<int>> r; for(int i = 0; i < n - 3; i++){ if(i > 0 && a[i] == a[i-1]) continue; for(int j = i + 1; j < n - 2; j++){ if(j > i + 1 && a[j] == a[j-1]) continue; int l = j + 1, h = n - 1; while(l < h){ long long s = (long long)a[i] + a[j] + a[l] + a[h]; if(s < t) l++; else if(s > t) h--; else { r.push_back({a[i], a[j], a[l], a[h]}); l++; h--; while(l < h && a[l] == a[l-1]) l++; while(l < h && a[h] == a[h+1]) h--; } } } } return r; }

problems.explanation: kSum ka general rule: (k-2) loops + 2 pointers = O(n^(k-1)). Values 1e9 tak hain, isliye sum long long me.

problems.title: Container With Most Water
problems.problem_statement: Given n vertical lines with heights h[i], find two lines that together with the x-axis form a container holding the most water. Return the maximum area.
problems.description: Container tilt nahi hota. Area = min(height) * width.
problems.theory: l = 0, r = n-1. Area nikalo, phir chhoti height wala pointer move karo kyunki uski height se bada area ab width ghatne par mil nahi sakta.

brute_force.approach: Saare pairs (i, j) ka area.
brute_force.code_cpp: int maxArea(const vector<int>& h){ int n = h.size(), best = 0; for(int i = 0; i < n; i++) for(int j = i + 1; j < n; j++) best = max(best, min(h[i], h[j]) * (j - i)); return best; }

optimized.code_cpp: int maxArea(const vector<int>& h){ int l = 0, r = (int)h.size() - 1, best = 0; while(l < r){ best = max(best, min(h[l], h[r]) * (r - l)); if(h[l] < h[r]) l++; else r--; } return best; }

problems.explanation: Proof idea: chhoti line ke saath har naye partner ka area <= current area (width kam, height limited by chhoti line). Isliye chhoti line ko hata dena safe hai.

problems.title: Trapping Rain Water
problems.problem_statement: Given n non-negative integers representing an elevation map (bar width 1), compute how much water it can trap after raining.
problems.description: Har bar ke upar pani = min(left max, right max) - height.
problems.theory: Two pointers with lmax aur rmax. Jis side ki height chhoti hai uski side ka pani pakka (limiting side wahi hai); us side ka pointer aage badhao.

brute_force.approach: Har i ke liye leftMax aur rightMax loop se.
brute_force.code_cpp: int trap(const vector<int>& h){ int n = h.size(), r = 0; for(int i = 0; i < n; i++){ int lm = 0, rm = 0; for(int j = 0; j <= i; j++) lm = max(lm, h[j]); for(int j = i; j < n; j++) rm = max(rm, h[j]); r += min(lm, rm) - h[i]; } return r; }

optimized.code_cpp: int trap(const vector<int>& h){ int l = 0, r = (int)h.size() - 1, lm = 0, rm = 0, res = 0; while(l < r){ if(h[l] < h[r]){ lm = max(lm, h[l]); res += lm - h[l]; l++; } else { rm = max(rm, h[r]); res += rm - h[r]; r--; } } return res; }

problems.explanation: Intermediate approach: leftMax[] aur rightMax[] arrays banao (O(n) space). Two pointers se wo arrays bhi hat jaate hain. Monotonic stack se bhi hota hai (Level 3).

problems.title: Boats to Save People
problems.problem_statement: Each boat carries at most two people and a maximum weight limit. Given weights of people, return the minimum number of boats needed (each person's weight <= limit).
problems.description: Ek boat me max 2 log, total weight limit se zyada nahi.
problems.theory: Sort karo. Sabse bhaari ke saath sabse halka bithao (agar fit ho). Fit nahi hota to bhaari akela jata hai.

brute_force.approach: Sort + har bhaari ke liye sabse bhaari fit hone wala partner O(n) me dhundo.
brute_force.code_cpp: int numRescueBoats(vector<int> p, int limit){ sort(p.begin(), p.end()); int n = p.size(); vector<bool> used(n, false); int boats = 0; for(int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--){ if(used[i]) continue; used[i] = true; boats++; for(int j = i - 1; j >= 0; j--) if(!used[j] && p[i] + p[j] <= limit){ used[j] = true; break; } } return boats; }

optimized.code_cpp: int numRescueBoats(vector<int> p, int limit){ sort(p.begin(), p.end()); int l = 0, r = (int)p.size() - 1, b = 0; while(l <= r){ if(p[l] + p[r] <= limit) l++; r--; b++; } return b; }

problems.explanation: Greedy argument: agar bhaari ke saath halka bhi fit nahi hota to bhaari kisi ke saath pair nahi ho sakta. Isliye bhaari akela jata hai.

problems.title: Valid Triangle Number
problems.problem_statement: Given an array of side lengths, return the number of triplets that can form a triangle.
problems.description: Triangle ke liye har do sides ka sum teesri side se bada hona chahiye.
problems.theory: Sort karo. Sabse badi side k fix karo; l = 0, r = k-1. a[l] + a[r] > a[k] ho to l se r-1 tak sab valid (r-l count), r--; warna l++.

brute_force.approach: Saare triplets (i < j < k) par teeno inequalities check.
brute_force.code_cpp: int triangleNumber(const vector<int>& a){ int n = a.size(), c = 0; for(int i = 0; i < n; i++) for(int j = i + 1; j < n; j++) for(int k = j + 1; k < n; k++) if(a[i] + a[j] > a[k] && a[i] + a[k] > a[j] && a[j] + a[k] > a[i]) c++; return c; }

optimized.code_cpp: int triangleNumber(vector<int> a){ sort(a.begin(), a.end()); int n = a.size(), c = 0; for(int k = n - 1; k >= 2; k--){ int l = 0, r = k - 1; while(l < r){ if(a[l] + a[r] > a[k]){ c += r - l; r--; } else l++; } } return c; }

problems.explanation: Sorted me sirf ek inequality (a + b > c, c sabse badi) check karni padti hai. Match par l..r-1 ke saare elements r ke saath valid hote hain, isliye ek saath count.

problems.title: Two Sum Less Than K
problems.problem_statement: Given an array and integer k, return the maximum sum of two elements (i < j) that is less than k, or -1 if no such pair exists.
problems.description: Pairs ka order matter nahi karta, isliye sort kar sakte hain.
problems.theory: Sort + two pointers: sum < k par best update aur l++ (bada sum try), warna r--.

brute_force.approach: Saare pairs.
brute_force.code_cpp: int twoSumLessThanK(const vector<int>& a, int k){ int n = a.size(), best = -1; for(int i = 0; i < n; i++) for(int j = i + 1; j < n; j++){ int s = a[i] + a[j]; if(s < k) best = max(best, s); } return best; }

optimized.code_cpp: int twoSumLessThanK(vector<int> a, int k){ sort(a.begin(), a.end()); int l = 0, r = (int)a.size() - 1, best = -1; while(l < r){ int s = a[l] + a[r]; if(s < k){ best = max(best, s); l++; } else r--; } return best; }

problems.explanation: Two Sum II ka variation: 'closest below target'. Pointers ki movement ka reason wahi: sum chhota hai to bada karo, bada hai to chhota.

problems.title: Backspace String Compare
problems.problem_statement: Given two strings s and t where '#' means a backspace, return true if they are equal after processing all backspaces.
problems.description: Khali text par backspace kuch nahi karta. Follow-up: O(1) extra space.
problems.theory: Peeche se scan: '#' mile to skip count badhao, skip > 0 ho to character chhodo. Dono strings ke agle valid characters compare karo.

brute_force.approach: Stack-style string build karke compare.
brute_force.code_cpp:
string build(const string& s){ string r; for(char c : s){ if(c == '#'){ if(!r.empty()) r.pop_back(); } else r += c; } return r; }
bool backspaceCompare(const string& a, const string& b){ return build(a) == build(b); }

optimized.approach: Do pointers peeche se, O(1) space.
optimized.code_cpp: bool backspaceCompare(const string& s, const string& t){ int i = (int)s.size() - 1, j = (int)t.size() - 1; auto next = [&](const string& x, int p){ int skip = 0; while(p >= 0){ if(x[p] == '#'){ skip++; p--; } else if(skip > 0){ skip--; p--; } else break; } return p; }; while(i >= 0 || j >= 0){ i = next(s, i); j = next(t, j); if(i < 0 && j < 0) return true; if(i < 0 || j < 0) return false; if(s[i] != t[j]) return false; i--; j--; } return true; }

problems.explanation: Peeche se isliye kyunki backspace apne se pehle ke characters ko hi hatata hai. Aage se scan karne par ye pata nahi chalta ki kaun sa character mitega.

problems.title: Longest Mountain in Array
problems.problem_statement: A mountain subarray has length >= 3, strictly increases up to a peak, then strictly decreases. Return the length of the longest mountain, or 0.
problems.description: Peak pehle/aakhri index par nahi ho sakta, aur plateau (equal values) allowed nahi.
problems.theory: Har peak (a[i-1] < a[i] > a[i+1]) se left aur right expand karo. Mountain ke baad i = r par jump karo, to total O(n).

brute_force.approach: Saare subarrays par mountain check.
brute_force.code_cpp:
bool isMt(const vector<int>& a, int i, int j){ if(j - i + 1 < 3) return false; int k = i; while(k < j && a[k] < a[k+1]) k++; if(k == i || k == j) return false; while(k < j && a[k] > a[k+1]) k++; return k == j; }
int longestMountain(const vector<int>& a){ int n = a.size(), best = 0; for(int i = 0; i < n; i++) for(int j = i + 2; j < n; j++) if(isMt(a, i, j)) best = max(best, j - i + 1); return best; }

optimized.code_cpp: int longestMountain(const vector<int>& a){ int n = a.size(), best = 0, i = 1; while(i < n - 1){ if(a[i-1] < a[i] && a[i] > a[i+1]){ int l = i - 1; while(l > 0 && a[l-1] < a[l]) l--; int r = i + 1; while(r < n - 1 && a[r] > a[r+1]) r++; best = max(best, r - l + 1); i = r; } else i++; } return best; }

problems.explanation: Har element zyada se zyada ek hi mountain ke andar expand hota hai, isliye total kaam O(n). Valid Mountain Array (L1-058) ka longest version.

problems.title: Number of Subsequences That Satisfy the Given Sum Condition
problems.problem_statement: Given an array and target, return the number of non-empty subsequences such that min + max <= target. Answer modulo 1e9 + 7.
problems.description: Subsequence ke elements ka order matter nahi karta (sirf min aur max), isliye sort kar sakte hain.
problems.theory: Sort karo. l = min, r = max. a[l] + a[r] <= t ho to l ko min rakhke beech ke r-l elements free (2^(r-l) subsequences); phir l++. Warna r--.

brute_force.approach: Saare subsets enumerate (bitmask, sirf chhote n ke liye).
brute_force.code_cpp: int numSubseq(const vector<int>& a, int t){ int n = a.size(); long long c = 0; for(int m = 1; m < (1 << n); m++){ int mn = INT_MAX, mx = INT_MIN; for(int i = 0; i < n; i++) if((m >> i) & 1){ mn = min(mn, a[i]); mx = max(mx, a[i]); } if(mn + mx <= t) c++; } return c % 1000000007; }

optimized.approach: Sort + two pointers + precomputed powers of 2.
optimized.code_cpp: int numSubseq(vector<int> a, int t){ const long long MOD = 1000000007; sort(a.begin(), a.end()); int n = a.size(); vector<long long> p2(n, 1); for(int i = 1; i < n; i++) p2[i] = p2[i-1] * 2 % MOD; int l = 0, r = n - 1; long long res = 0; while(l <= r){ if(a[l] + a[r] <= t){ res = (res + p2[r - l]) % MOD; l++; } else r--; } return (int)res; }

problems.explanation: Subsequence me sirf min aur max matter karte hain. Min = a[l] fix hone par l+1..r me se koi bhi subset le sakte ho, isliye 2^(r-l). Modulo har step par.

problems.title: Subarrays with K Different Integers
problems.problem_statement: Given an integer array and k, return the number of contiguous subarrays that have exactly k different integers.
problems.description: Exactly k directly window se nahi nikalta; atMost trick lagta hai.
problems.theory: Exactly k = atMost(k) - atMost(k-1). atMost(k): variable window me distinct <= k rakho aur har r par r-l+1 count karo.

brute_force.approach: Har start se extend; distinct set ka size k par count++.
brute_force.code_cpp: int subarraysWithKDistinct(const vector<int>& a, int k){ int n = a.size(), c = 0; for(int i = 0; i < n; i++){ set<int> s; for(int j = i; j < n; j++){ s.insert(a[j]); if((int)s.size() == k) c++; else if((int)s.size() > k) break; } } return c; }

optimized.code_cpp:
int atMost(const vector<int>& a, int k){ if(k <= 0) return 0; unordered_map<int,int> f; int l = 0, c = 0; for(int r = 0; r < (int)a.size(); r++){ f[a[r]]++; while((int)f.size() > k){ if(--f[a[l]] == 0) f.erase(a[l]); l++; } c += r - l + 1; } return c; }
int subarraysWithKDistinct(const vector<int>& a, int k){ return atMost(a, k) - atMost(a, k - 1); }

problems.explanation: Ye Part 1 ke 'Count Nice Subarrays' wali trick ka hard version hai. Distinct count ko map.size() se maintain karte hain (erase zaroori).

problems.title: Max Number of K-Sum Pairs
problems.problem_statement: In one operation you pick two numbers from the array that sum to k and remove them. Return the maximum number of operations.
problems.description: Har element ek hi baar use ho sakta hai.
problems.theory: Sort + two pointers: sum == k par count++ aur dono move, sum < k to l++, warna r--.

brute_force.approach: Har unused element ke liye uska complement dhundo (used flags).
brute_force.code_cpp: int maxOperations(const vector<int>& a, int k){ int n = a.size(), c = 0; vector<bool> u(n, false); for(int i = 0; i < n; i++){ if(u[i]) continue; for(int j = i + 1; j < n; j++) if(!u[j] && a[i] + a[j] == k){ u[i] = u[j] = true; c++; break; } } return c; }

optimized.code_cpp: int maxOperations(vector<int> a, int k){ sort(a.begin(), a.end()); int l = 0, r = (int)a.size() - 1, c = 0; while(l < r){ int s = a[l] + a[r]; if(s == k){ c++; l++; r--; } else if(s < k) l++; else r--; } return c; }

problems.explanation: Alternative: HashMap se frequency rakho (unsorted me bhi O(n)). Sorted two pointers me extra memory nahi lagti.
